args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (blog.bellwether.example/2026/cold-chain).
• Linked article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
• Companion piece: Pilots cut claims by a quarter.
